title: Offer the review on reconcile and release
goal: Adopting projects are offered the skill discovery review when they reconcile
acceptance: APPLY's reconcile offers reviews.skills.days and says the first run becomes a record in the project's own backlog
CHANGELOG and version bumped; the release is published
privacy: Procedure and config text only; examples invented; no personal data.
escalation: A discovery rule that would make the harness own a project's skills goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23: one reconcile prompt and a minor release.
